about_the_game:
Welcome to Loot Shop Simulator – the cozy, fantasy shop sim where you open all of the loot boxes… and then resell the loot to your (extremely loyal) customers! Decorate your shop, hoard rare gear, and hustle cursed swords to adventurers on suspiciously personal quests.

Key Features

Crack Boxes, Get Rich

Open a variety of loot boxes from totally legitimate, fantasy sets like Legend of the NFT-Eyed, Lootbox Dragon and Wrath of the Witch King! Get swords, get sparkles, get mildly suspicious rings. Then sell them. For gold.

Decorate for Vibes

Want some cozy rugs? How about a completely unnecessary dragon statue? Your shop’s charm brings in foot traffic—and the occasional weirdo with a story to tell.

Collect the Good Stuff

Each loot set has its own wacky theme and shiny nonsense. From humble Irony Swords to legendary pray-to-win artifacts, stock your shelves with treasure and flex your rarest finds.

Expand That Empire

Hire help, grow the shop, and automate your way to decorative retail domination.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3GHz 4-Core or similar
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 3.5GHz 6-Core or similar

short_description: Run the coziest shop in the realm by cracking cursed crates, selling enchanted junk, and helping weird customers with weirder problems. Business is booming… maybe too booming.
